Definition: from G1321; an instructor (genitive case or specially):--doctor, master, teacher.
BiblicalUsage: A teacher is one who teaches, and the word is used of Jesus above all, and then of the church's teachers. The disciples call Him Master, the church is given teachers among its gifts, and James warns that teachers will receive the stricter judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the title teacher belongs first to Christ. He is the Master who teaches with authority, and every teacher in the church stands under His judgment, which is why James says we should not be many masters.
